But STRAIGHT TO deep midwicket. Bhuvneshwar just missed the yorker narrowly, Hetmyer seemed to have gotten under it. He flicked it away using all his wristpower but straight to Padikkal, who takes it despite the sun being in his eyes. 169/4PhotosYash Dayal403619.0090013.2 to R Parag, What a wicket. Out of nowhere. The most undramatic soft dismissal. And Parag is out of here. Short and outside off from around the stumps, he looks to go over cover but hits it to short cover where Kohli crouches and takes it over his head. It was the back of the hand slower ball. Dayal dropped Parag earlier, now dismisses him to break a 55-run stand. 105/2Josh Hazlewood302618.6670015.6 to YBK Jaiswal, Hits his pads and given! Hazlewood's celebrappeal helps but Jaiswal reviews it. It is a slower length ball from around the wicket, he gets across to swipe across the line but misses and is hit on the knee-roll. He is on his knee, so height perhaps won't be a concern. Three reds and that's that for Jaiswal. Timely strike for RCB with death overs looming. 126/3Krunal Pandya402917.256006.5 to SV Samson, misses it completely and he's gone!
